narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about the historical and political reasons behind the overlap of Christmas and Constitution Day in Taiwan. It explains how Chiang Kai-shek, a Christian, strategically chose the date to highlight the difference between the ROC and the anti-religious Communist party, thereby gaining Western support and legitimacy.
